requirements.requirement: The K1 product path is read-only Repository Understanding plus conservative Change Impact; it exposes no edit, apply, patch, or reusable mutation authority.
requirements.verification: Static API and CLI scan plus source-before/source-after equality for every corpus run.

requirements.requirement: The immutable corpus contains exactly 12 pinned real Kotlin/JVM repositories split into 6 qualification and 6 blind holdout entries, from at least 6 organizations and no more than 2 repositories per organization.
requirements.verification: Corpus manifest schema, exact commit/tree pins, uniqueness, cohort and organization counts.

requirements.requirement: The corpus contains at least 3 Gradle Kotlin DSL, 3 Gradle Groovy DSL, and 3 Maven repositories; the selected JVM compilation is explicit for every entry.
requirements.verification: Frozen build metadata and selected-compilation manifest fields.

requirements.requirement: The corpus covers declared Kotlin 2.1.x, 2.3.x, and 2.4.x projects. Evidence binds both the declared project compiler/toolchain and the exact trusted analyzer compiler; minor-line compatibility is never represented as exact compiler identity.
requirements.verification: Snapshot and provider provenance comparison for at least one validated output in each line.

requirements.requirement: Gradle and Maven discovery preserves ordered compiler arguments and binds build root, project/module, source set, target, platform, JDK, plugin identities, generated-source configuration, and every unavailable field as an explicit boundary.
requirements.verification: Build-model conformance fixtures, argument-order mutation, absent reflective field, multi-module Gradle and Maven runs.

requirements.requirement: Dependency identity is more than a classpath string list: it commits ordered classpath members and bytes, resolved coordinates/scopes when the build provider exposes them, repositories, selected module/reactor, and plugin/buildscript inputs. Missing closure produces a typed boundary or refusal.
requirements.verification: Jar-byte, classpath-order, coordinate, scope, repository, plugin and missing-artifact mutations.

requirements.requirement: Every result is bound to an exact clean Git commit/tree and a content-addressed source/build/dependency/toolchain snapshot. Generated, user, vendored and external artifacts are distinguished; source and Git state are unchanged after analysis.
requirements.verification: Before/after hashes and Git status, dirty/source/generated/config/toolchain mutation counterexamples.

requirements.requirement: Kotlin-owned translation is total over future compiler enum values and malformed individual FIR rows. Unknown declaration kind, visibility, effective visibility, modality, type rendering, relation, identity or range becomes a deterministic typed boundary and cannot panic or silently disappear.
requirements.verification: Table-driven known enum contour, synthetic future values, the effectiveVisibility=local constructor regression, malformed-row and reference-to-quarantined-row tests.

requirements.requirement: Every selected run produces exactly one canonical retained attempt: either a validated AdapterOutput plus evidence-core binding or a typed PARTIAL, REFUSED or FAILED attempt with stage, reason code, safe detail hash, snapshot/provenance and cost. Panic, OOM, timeout, nonzero child exit, invalid JSON or empty stdout cannot be the only artifact.
requirements.verification: Injected worker crash, timeout, OOM-like termination, invalid/truncated JSON, build failure and direct-adapter exception tests.

requirements.requirement: UNKNOWN is contagious through mandatory closure. No quarantined row, incomplete enumeration, unsupported build feature, generated/source-map gap or dynamic boundary may yield false PROVEN, COMPILER_CHECKED, COMPLETE_IN_SCOPE, or an omitted mandatory obligation.
requirements.verification: Adversarial completeness, grade, boundary and obligation tests; zero false-positive counter.

requirements.requirement: A successful result provides a canonical bounded source-free repository projection and a conservative may-impact result. Budget exhaustion is PARTIAL_BUDGET; unsupported closure is PARTIAL_BOUNDARY, UNKNOWN or REFUSED.
requirements.verification: Byte/node/depth caps, deterministic expansion, unrelated-padding and mandatory-boundary tests.

requirements.requirement: A cross-process warm semantic cache is content-addressed by every semantic input, revalidated before use, and never trusts caller-owned cache JSON. Cache corruption, stale build/plugin/dependency/source state and symlink/path escape fail closed.
requirements.verification: Cold/warm process pair plus forged, stale, truncated, corrupted, symlink and input-drift cache tests.

requirements.requirement: After an explicit network-enabled dependency preparation phase, decision runs execute with network denied and build tools in offline mode. Two runs over the same snapshot have identical semantic projection digests.
requirements.verification: macOS sandbox network denial, Gradle --offline/Maven -o evidence, no download marker, two-run semantic digest equality.

requirements.requirement: Every attempt records external wall time and maximum RSS plus internal source hashing, build discovery, dependency preparation/verification, adapter startup, cold/warm index, provider processing, serialization, store, query, bytes read/written/emitted, fact/boundary counts and cache request/hit telemetry.
requirements.verification: Exact telemetry schema and nonnegative/presence checks for all 12 entries; UNKNOWN is explicit when the platform cannot observe a metric.

requirements.requirement: Holdout source semantics, tests, issues and adapter outcomes are not inspected before the candidate source/binary/harness/threshold freeze. Only repository identity and build/config metadata may be used for eligibility.
requirements.verification: Stage journal, immutable implementation freeze and independent eligibility audit.

requirements.requirement: The readiness graph, requirements and corpus are production-pinned. Caller-supplied alternate graphs, thresholds, corpus rows, digests, success strings or failure reports cannot mint readiness.
requirements.verification: Alternate-graph/corpus/threshold, forged receipt, cross-store and stale-input executable counterexamples.

requirements.requirement: Canonical success and failure identities exclude timestamps and volatile paths but include exact semantic inputs, ordered compiler arguments, boundaries, facts, impact obligations and provider identities.
requirements.verification: Reordered true sets remain equivalent; ordered-argument changes do not; timestamp/path-only changes preserve semantic digest.

requirements.requirement: Repository-owned build code is executed only in an explicit isolated preparation/analysis contour with no production credentials, an external output/cache root, path/symlink checks, bounded subprocess groups and no model/controller access.
requirements.verification: Environment allowlist, path containment, timeout/process-group and denied-secret tripwires.

requirements.requirement: Existing baseline failures remain visible and are not attributed to K1. K0.1 verification and focused new-package tests must be green before the holdout freeze.
requirements.verification: Retained pre/post command packets and byte-exact K0.1 verification.

requirements.requirement: K1 performs zero model calls and does not implement Rust/TypeScript portability, edit/apply, JBMC, ByteBack, universal AST/IR, benchmark-family dispatch or repository-specific semantic recipes.
requirements.verification: Static scan, command audit and modelCalls=0 in the final matrix.

workloadPolicy.selectionRule: For each frozen selected compilation, enumerate validated adapter entities after the cold run and choose the lexicographically smallest RESOLVED entity with a source definition and at least one incident relation fact. If none exists, the repository is a typed refusal and is not a projection success.
workloadPolicy.nonemptyProjectionDefinition: The generic runtime validates the output into evidence-core, emits at least one entity, one relation fact, one source-bound occurrence and one impact receipt with at least one affected entity or a mandatory boundary obligation tied to the selected seed.
antiGaming: A projection without an evidence-core binding is not a success.
An all-repository may-impact set without evidence paths is not a success.
A caller-selected seed, source name, repository recipe or post-outcome fallback seed is forbidden.

pairedRunPolicy.cold: Fresh external Codeclew state and semantic cache; preverified dependency seed remains available; network denied.
pairedRunPolicy.warm: New adapter and worker processes over the exact same source/build/dependency/tool snapshot and the cold run's externally published semantic cache; network denied.
pairedRunPolicy.terminalSemanticDigest: For ADAPTER_OUTPUT, hash the evidence-core bundle/projection after removing only preregistered timing and absolute staging-path metadata. For TYPED_REFUSAL or FAILED, hash the canonical stage, reason, safe detail hash, selected inputs, boundaries and provenance after removing only timing and absolute staging paths.
pairedRunPolicy.warmRatioPopulation: Warm/cold ratios are computed only for repositories with two validated ADAPTER_OUTPUT results and a verified semantic cache hit. Refusals remain in applicability and replay denominators but never improve cache ratios.
pairedRunPolicy.retryPolicy: Qualification may rerun only after a new candidate version and then all six qualification members restart. Holdout has no product-fix retry; a byte-identical rerun is allowed only when the retained supervisor proves failure occurred before the candidate process was started.

decisionRules.GO: All requirements and numeric thresholds pass; issue KOTLIN_REAL_REPOSITORY_READY.
decisionRules.PIVOT: Totality and proof safety pass, but applicability, offline closure, cache or cost thresholds fail; issue KOTLIN_APPLICABILITY_OR_COST_GAP without changing the corpus or thresholds.
decisionRules.STOP: Any false PROVEN/COMPLETE, source mutation, K0.1 drift, authority bypass, post-freeze holdout tuning, corpus/threshold rewrite, or unretained failure invalidates the series.
